experiment: E63 full-chain adaptive attack on E55 main_online_pgd7 plus E36 logSPD/WCCN hard routing
forbidden_reuse: E38-E52 including E40; no FrozenPrototype import; no Test access

identity_model.artifact_validation: E55 config/script/E54 script hashes plus saved model fingerprint; no retraining or outcome-based selection in E63

logspd_model.implementation: E36 gpu_logspd -> detrend_zband -> E36 TorchPrototype(wccn=True), independently wrapped for differentiable raw-waveform forward in E63
logspd_model.fit_features: E36 train_detrend_zband_cov5.npy, current fold fit samples only
logspd_model.attack_features: recomputed from current attacked raw waveform at every FGSM/PGD step

routing.threshold_source: current inner run clean-known attack subset only; no outer, unknown or Test values
routing.soft_route: sigmoid on log(dr) thresholds; three normalized soft weights for rejection/logSPD/E55; straight-through hard-forward and soft-backward
routing.direct_decision: same high/low identity routing with rejection disabled; dr>=tau_high -> logSPD else E55
routing.hard_soft_audit: straight-through weight forward error and independent hard-decision label mismatch at every step

attacks.radius: per-trial L2 norm after temporal demeaning divided by 10^(SNR/20)
attacks.initialization: FGSM zero; PGD one seeded random L2 point uniformly scaled inside radius; one start and no EOT
attacks.update: L2-normalized gradient, FGSM radius step or PGD 2*radius/20, followed by per-trial L2 projection
attacks.target_rule: next identity in sorted enrolled-class cycle
attacks.direct_loss: signed CE of hard-forward/ST-soft-backward two-branch routed identity logits; no rejection loss
attacks.threshold_loss: direct identity loss plus rejection_weight * mean softplus((log(dr)-log(tau_low))/rejection_temperature); targeted identity CE drives next-class false acceptance and rejection term drives dr below tau_low
required_audit: nonzero total/E55/logSPD raw-branch gradient every step
actual step and full-chain forward counts

protocol.data: Train session1 only; E55 metadata loader and E55 inner_layout
protocol.subset_rule: E54/E55 stratified_subset sorted by subject/task/trial/path; first 8, no outcome sampling
protocol.clean_metrics: all current inner known continuous-block and calibration/eval-unknown samples; per-attack Score uses the same stratified subset as E58/E59
protocol.train_fit: all current fit-known samples through the actual raw-waveform E55+logSPD/WCCN hard fusion; report direct and rejection-inclusive values
protocol.aggregation: pool two inner runs within each outer group using each run's own fixed thresholds, then unweighted mean over five outer groups; macro over six attacks
protocol.outer_rule: N/A unless every fixed-threshold inner gate passes; never use outer for threshold review

smoke.scope: all 2 objectives x 6 attacks, real FGSM/PGD20, every-step branch gradient/ST/SNR audit; no model selection

threshold_review.enabled_only_if: fixed-threshold inner is near all gates: every clean gate passes and both objectives have direct_RA>=0.90, threshold_RA>=0.90 and ASafeR>=0.95
threshold_review.selection: maximum complete adaptive threshold-objective Score subject to pooled clean-known acceptance>=0.95; inner only
threshold_review.status_preregistered: not run unless fixed results meet enabled_only_if; fixed q02/q05 remains the primary result

e58_nonadaptive_reference.gradient_scope: CNN only; logSPD/dr and routing passive forward only

reporting.auc: AUROC uses known=1/unknown=0 and larger dr means known; AUPR is unknown-class with -dr
reporting.evidence_boundary: Train-only inner pseudo-unknown and continuous file-block proxy, not cross-session or official-new-subject evidence; E58 is non-adaptive reference only; outer/Test=N/A unless explicitly gated, and Test is never read
